title.from: The welcome message became the boss
title.to: The project arrived with a manager

description.from: Board draft requested by Ryan on 29 September 2026. One documented research scene: the AgentWorm paper’s representative Alice–Bob–Carol exchange, in which a welcome induces a standing-rule change and the recipient passes it to the next test agent. Reporting and editorial artifacts are in stories/PILO-de5a6b3a-37e0-4c0d-ade4-ea6b3d699d1e/. Original OpenAI email finding provides a short contextual echo; the every-future-email version remains explicitly conditional. Controlled experiment, no claimed live outbreak. Draft pending Ryan’s review.
